Cyclad

Senior QA Automation Engineer | 10.2020 — present

Techstack
C#, .NET, nUnit, Selenium WebDriver, SQLite, QTest, JIRA, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket

more details

Developed a centralized testing platform for a complex ecosystem of credit and insurance reporting systems. The solution replaced a fragmented set of legacy tools, including Ranorex, Postman, SpecFlow, and custom Java-based frameworks, with a unified C# testing ecosystem. The desktop application enables manual QA engineers to execute Web UI and API regression test suites with minimal programming expertise, while ensuring seamless integration with automated CI/CD pipelines. This significantly improved test consistency, maintainability, and overall testing efficiency across multiple systems, reducing regression testing from a multi-day effort requiring several testers to a fully automated process that that produces reliable results within 3 hours.

Key responsibilities

  • Developed automated web UI and API tests, from zero to full scope coverage of core features, which reduced regression testing from a multi-day effort requiring several testers to a fully automated process that that produces reliable results within hours
  • Developed and maintaining an in-house desktop testing application used by QA teams to execute automated test scenarios, replacing a complex web of several legacy tools
  • Designed and implemented a scalable, layered test automation architecture from scratch, including reusable frameworks, libraries, and testing components
  • Created and maintained databases for test user credentials and test data management
  • Collected and archived test execution metrics, automation usage statistics and test results
  • Implemented JSON-based configuration management and prepared manuals for non-technical users
  • Collaborated within an Agile, self-organizing team environment, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and delivery planning
  • Developed and maintained automated Web UI and API regression test suites, expanding scope coverage from zero to full validation of critical business processes
